title: AI Explanation Language & Turbo Builds
message: GabAI v0.3.7 fixes AI explanation language settings (English, Taglish, Tagalog) and adds an interactive language switcher directly in Overview!
changelog:
• AI Explanation Language Directives: Gemini now accurately explains concepts in Tagalog, Taglish, or English as selected
• In-Overview Language Switcher: Added direct language badge button to toggle explanation language on the fly
• Fast Build Optimizations: Tuned Gradle daemon memory and parallel compilation for sub-10s wireless deployments
• Dual Credential Autofill: Perfectly links username and password fields in system Autofill and password managers
